	import TimeSegment from './time-segment.svelte';

	import { cn } from '$UTILS$';

	let {

		class?: string;
		unstyled?: boolean;
	} = $props();
</script>

<TimeField.Input
	{...restProps}
	class={cn(
		!unstyled &&

>
